acceptance.cards: Tier A only; unique card id and official image host required
acceptance.decklists: Public event page, complete 66-card export and valid zone totals required. The verified official RC Europe article is accepted; explicitly unpublished attendance remains null and must carry a note, never inferred from submitted deck counts.
acceptance.metagame: Published sample size and current-format date required; cross-check with a second Tier B source
acceptance.social: Never accepted as sole evidence for rules, card text, decklists or win rates

quarantineOn: missing event date or unlabelled missing player count
non-Radiance event mixed into current snapshot
